new.title: New absence
new.reassurance: Your open cases stay as they are.
new.info_body: The practitioner is blocked in Termino for the period. The rescheduling assistant checks every appointment in the period: what fits safely is rebooked and the patient gets an SMS or email. The rest goes to "Open cases".

list.title: Absences
list.subtitle: Today and upcoming · one absence with a period per practitioner

queue.title: Open cases
queue.subtitle: {{count}} cases · sorted by urgency
queue.empty_body: New absences or the next Termino reconciliation fill the list again.
queue.assistant_summary: Rescheduling assistant: {{count}} patients rebooked and notified
queue.proposals_label: Offer a replacement slot – proposals of the assistant
queue.proposals_hint: One click books the slot in Termino and notifies the patient.

todo.swap_proposal: Confirm the colleague at the same time.
todo.proposal: Call and offer a replacement slot.
todo.front_desk: Call and find a replacement slot.
todo.front_desk_in_progress: Treatment is running – settle it on site.
todo.front_desk_imminent_no_swap: Arrives shortly. Receive on site, offer a replacement.
todo.front_desk_no_slot: Call: waiting list or a slot from next week.
todo.front_desk_not_contactable: No way to reach the patient – speak to them on site.

reason.imminent_no_swap: No practitioner is free at the same time. The patient is probably on the way.
reason.no_slot: No fitting replacement slot inside the window.
reason.not_contactable: Neither a phone number nor an email is on file.

script.walk_in: The patient arrives shortly. Explain on site, offer a replacement slot, mention the waiting time.
script.proposal: "Hello, this is meinphysio+. Your appointment today at {{time}} with {{practitioner}} cannot happen. We have replacement slots – does one of them fit?"
script.no_slot: "Hello, this is meinphysio+. Your appointment today at {{time}} cannot happen. We have no replacement for {{service}} this week. May we put you on the waiting list, or book a slot from next week?"

toast.not_reached: {{name}}: not reached – stays in the list
toast.accept: {{name}}: rebooked – Termino write and message in the outbox

queue.detail_empty: Choose a case on the left.

cancel_confirm.title: Cancel the appointment?
cancel_confirm.body: The appointment of {{name}} on {{time}} will be cancelled. {{name}} gets a cancellation notice by SMS or email right away. Only a new appointment undoes this.

warnings.no_prescription: No prescription on file – self-payer assumed
